basic_details.job_title: IGDTUW Faculty Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for 36 Professor, Associate Professor & Assistant Professor Posts
basic_details.organization_name: Indira Gandhi Delhi Technical University for Women (IGDTUW), Delhi
basic_details.short_information: Indira Gandhi Delhi Technical University for Women (IGDTUW), Delhi has released Recruitment Notice No. 01/2026 for direct recruitment of Teaching Positions (Group-A) on a regular basis. The recruitment notification invites online applications from eligible candidates for Professor, Associate Professor and Assistant Professor posts across various departments.

application_fee.details: Candidates applying for IGDTUW Faculty Recruitment 2026 have to pay the application fee according to their category. | The application fee is non-transferable and non-refundable. Candidates applying for more than one post/department must submit a separate application form along with the prescribed fee for each post.

age_limit.details: The age limit for IGDTUW Faculty Recruitment 2026 depends on the post applied for. The maximum age limit mentioned in the notification is as follows: | Age relaxation is applicable as per Government of NCT of Delhi rules. The notification mentions relaxation up to 5 years for SC/ST/PwBD candidates, up to 3 years for OBC candidates, and relaxation for Government servants and teachers of government-funded higher education institutions as per applicable rules.

qualification.details: The required qualification for IGDTUW Faculty Recruitment 2026 varies according to the teaching post and discipline. Candidates must possess the required degree from a recognized university/institute along with the required academic and professional experience. | For Professor posts, candidates must generally have a Ph.D. degree in the relevant field along with first class or equivalent qualification at Bachelor's or Master's level. Candidates must also fulfil the required teaching, research or industry experience criteria. | Candidates applying for Associate Professor posts must have a Ph.D. degree in the relevant field along with required teaching/research experience and research publications. | The qualification requirements for Assistant Professor posts differ according to the department. Candidates must have the relevant Bachelor's/Master's qualification and fulfil NET/Ph.D. requirements wherever applicable.

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: Ph.D. in relevant branch with first class or equivalent at Bachelor’s or Master’s level. Minimum 10 years teaching/research/industry experience, including required Associate Professor level experience and research publications.
Ph.D. in relevant field with first class or equivalent qualification. Minimum 10 years teaching/research/industry experience with research publications and Ph.D. guidance requirements.
Bachelor’s Degree in Architecture or equivalent B.Arch and Master’s Degree in Architecture/allied subjects with minimum 60% marks. Requires teaching/research/professional experience.

Bachelor’s Degree in Architecture/Planning/Civil Engineering or relevant Master's qualification, Master of Planning with first class, Ph.D. in relevant field and required teaching/research experience.
Ph.D. Degree in relevant field and first class or equivalent at Bachelor’s or Master’s level. Minimum 8 years teaching/research/industry experience with research publications.
Ph.D. Degree in relevant field with first class qualification and required teaching/research experience.
Bachelor’s Degree in Architecture/equivalent B.Arch and Master’s Degree in Architecture/allied subjects with minimum 60% marks along with required experience.
Bachelor’s Degree in Architecture/Planning/Civil Engineering or relevant qualification, Master of Planning with first class, Ph.D. degree and required teaching/research experience.
B.E./B.Tech./B.S. and M.E./M.Tech./M.S. or Integrated M.Tech. in relevant branch with first class or equivalent qualification. Ph.D. and research publications are desirable.

Bachelor’s Degree in Architecture or equivalent B.Arch with minimum 60% marks and required professional experience OR Bachelor's and Master's Degree in Architecture/allied subjects with required experience.
Bachelor’s Degree in Architecture/Planning/Civil Engineering or relevant Master's qualification, Master of Planning with first class and minimum required experience.
Master’s Degree with 55% marks in relevant/allied subject and qualification in NET/SLET/SET or eligible Ph.D. qualification as per applicable UGC regulations.

salary_details.details: Selected candidates under IGDTUW Faculty Recruitment 2026 will receive salary according to the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC) pay levels as mentioned in the notification.

selection_process: The selection process for IGDTUW Faculty Recruitment 2026 will be conducted as per the recruitment rules and procedures followed by Indira Gandhi Delhi Technical University for Women. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their application details

the university will conduct a screening test for shortlisting candidates. The shortlisted candidates will be required to give a presentation before the concerned department committee and other invited members of IGDTUW before appearing before the Selection Committee.

The notification states that the university may shortlist candidates through a written examination or any other suitable method before the final interview process. The final selection will be based on the performance of candidates before the Selection Committee.
how_to_apply: Eligible candidates can apply for IGDTUW Faculty Recruitment 2026 through the online application process available on the official website of IGDTUW.
Visit the official website of Indira Gandhi Delhi Technical University for Women at igdtuw.ac.in.
Open the recruitment section and find Recruitment Notice No. 01/2026.
Click on the online application link.
Register and fill in the required personal, educational and professional details.
Upload the required documents and certificates.
Pay the application fee according to the applicable category.
Submit the online application form before the last date.
Take a printout of the submitted application form.
Send the printed application form along with required documents and fee proof to the university address within the prescribed deadline.

Candidates are required to submit the printout of the online filled application form along with documentary evidence and prescribed fee to the Registrar, Indira Gandhi Delhi Technical University for Women, Kashmere Gate, Delhi - 110006.

content_sections.heading: IGDTUW Faculty Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: IGDTUW has announced vacancies for Professor, Associate Professor and Assistant Professor posts in different departments including Architecture and Planning, Applied Sciences & Humanities, Computer Science & Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Information Technology and Mechanical & Automation Engineering. content_sections.heading: IGDTUW Faculty Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for IGDTUW Faculty Recruitment 2026 must fulfil the educational qualification, experience and age requirements prescribed for the respective post and department. The detailed eligibility conditions vary according to the post and discipline. Professor, Associate Professor and Assistant Professor posts have separate qualification and experience requirements.

content_sections.heading: IGDTUW Faculty Recruitment 2026 Qualification
content_sections.text: The required qualification for IGDTUW Faculty Recruitment 2026 varies according to the teaching post and discipline. Candidates must possess the required degree from a recognized university/institute along with the required academic and professional experience. For Professor posts, candidates must generally have a Ph.D. degree in the relevant field along with first class or equivalent qualification at Bachelor's or Master's level. Candidates must also fulfil the required teaching, research or industry experience criteria. Candidates applying for Associate Professor posts must have a Ph.D. degree in the relevant field along with required teaching/research experience and research publications. The qualification requirements for Assistant Professor posts differ according to the department. Candidates must have the relevant Bachelor's/Master's qualification and fulfil NET/Ph.D. requirements wherever applicable.

content_sections.heading: IGDTUW Faculty Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The age limit for IGDTUW Faculty Recruitment 2026 depends on the post applied for. The maximum age limit mentioned in the notification is as follows: Age relaxation is applicable as per Government of NCT of Delhi rules. The notification mentions relaxation up to 5 years for SC/ST/PwBD candidates, up to 3 years for OBC candidates, and relaxation for Government servants and teachers of government-funded higher education institutions as per applicable rules.

content_sections.heading: IGDTUW Faculty Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for IGDTUW Faculty Recruitment 2026 have to pay the application fee according to their category. The application fee is non-transferable and non-refundable. Candidates applying for more than one post/department must submit a separate application form along with the prescribed fee for each post.

content_sections.heading: IGDTUW Faculty Recruitment 2026 Salary
content_sections.text: Selected candidates under IGDTUW Faculty Recruitment 2026 will receive salary according to the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC) pay levels as mentioned in the notification.

content_sections.heading: IGDTUW Faculty Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process for IGDTUW Faculty Recruitment 2026 will be conducted as per the recruitment rules and procedures followed by Indira Gandhi Delhi Technical University for Women. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their application details, qualifications, experience and other eligibility conditions. For Assistant Professor posts, the university will conduct a screening test for shortlisting candidates. The shortlisted candidates will be required to give a presentation before the concerned department committee and other invited members of IGDTUW before appearing before the Selection Committee. The notification states that the university may shortlist candidates through a written examination or any other suitable method before the final interview process. The final selection will be based on the performance of candidates before the Selection Committee.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IGDTUW Faculty Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply for IGDTUW Faculty Recruitment 2026 through the online application process available on the official website of IGDTUW. Visit the official website of Indira Gandhi Delhi Technical University for Women at igdtuw.ac.in . Open the recruitment section and find Recruitment Notice No. 01/2026. Click on the online application link. Register and fill in the required personal, educational and professional details. Upload the required documents and certificates. Pay the application fee according to the applicable category. Submit the online application form before the last date. Take a printout of the submitted application form. Send the printed application form along with required documents and fee proof to the university address within the prescribed deadline. Candidates are required to submit the printout of the online filled application form along with documentary evidence and prescribed fee to the Registrar, Indira Gandhi Delhi Technical University for Women, Kashmere Gate, Delhi - 110006.

faq.question: Q1. What is IGDTUW Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: IGDTUW Faculty Recruitment 2026 is a recruitment drive conducted by Indira Gandhi Delhi Technical University for Women (IGDTUW), Delhi for filling Group-A Teaching Positions on a regular basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in IGDTUW Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 36 teaching vacancies are available, including Professor, Associate Professor and Assistant Professor posts.

faq.question: Q3. Which posts are available under IGDTUW Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment includes Professor, Associate Professor and Assistant Professor positions in different departments.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for IGDTUW Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The qualification depends on the post and department. Candidates require relevant qualifications such as Ph.D., Master's Degree or Bachelor's Degree along with required teaching/research/professional experience as mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for IGDTUW Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit varies according to the post. Professor posts have a maximum age limit of 55 years, Associate Professor posts have 50 years, and Assistant Professor posts generally have 35 years, with some department-specific variations.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for IGDTUW Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹1,000 for UR candidates and ₹800 for OBC (NCL), EWS and Women candidates. SC/ST and PwBD candidates are exempted from paying the application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary of IGDTUW Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive salary according to 7th CPC pay levels. Professor posts carry Level-14 pay scale, Associate Professor posts carry Level-13A1 pay scale, and Assistant Professor posts carry Level-10 pay scale.

faq.question: Q8. What is the last date to apply for IGDTUW Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 21 August 2026 up to 11:59 PM.
